result.description: A fictional 34-inch curved ultrawide monitor designed for immersive workspace layouts, casual creative editing, and split-screen productivity. It features a 3440 x 1440 VA panel, 165Hz refresh rate, 1ms response mode, HDR10 support, and dual HDMI 2.0 plus DisplayPort 1.4 inputs. The stand offers height, tilt, and swivel adjustment, with VESA 100 x 100 compatibility for desk-mounted setups.
